text.value: Laboratory Report

tr.th: Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:

tr.td: The patient shows marked hypoxemia (low arterial oxygen saturation), mild leukopenia and lymphopenia, mild thrombocytopenia, and elevated basophils. Liver enzymes show low ALT and mildly elevated AST. Red cell parameters and other biochemistry are within normal limits. Findings may suggest acute or chronic hypoxic state and possible viral or inflammatory process; clinical correlation is recommended.
